title: Universal torsion classification for quartic self-fibers
objective: Classify the rational torsion of P=(-2p,2q) on V^2=U^3+2pU^2+4q^2 for every rational quartic parameter.

title: Generic degree-5 base-field parametrization locus
objective: Determine for which Shaska parameters (a,b) the corrected genus-zero component has a rational point over the minimal field of definition, and derive a generic parametrization where possible.

title: Generic degree-5 complementary j formula
objective: Derive a reproducible formula for the second degree-5 elliptic subcover directly from the two-parameter normal form.

title: Large exact census of degree 3, 4, and 5 examples
objective: Build a database of source curves, both elliptic factors, maps, fields of definition, ranks, torsion, and discrepancy flags.

title: Arithmetic of complementary factors over number fields
objective: Compute ranks, torsion, conductors, isogeny classes, and reduction data for systematic number-field families.

title: Automated source-to-CAS discrepancy detection
objective: Extract displayed formulas from TeX, normalize them, and compare them automatically with generated CAS identities.
